definition.label: HEURISTIC PROXY - NOT MEASURED GRAVITY
definition.summary: effective_gravity_g is a bookkeeping column. All PSI investigations are flight (ISS / Cygnus) at actual gravity_g = 0.0 (baseline stated by the project owner; see gravity_source). Where a flight test had a unit-proven forced-flow speed, the speed is mapped to the gravity that would drive an equal natural-convection velocity. This is NOT a measurement of partial-gravity flame behaviour.

methods.direct: effective gravity = actual gravity_g (no proxy applied)
methods.convective_velocity_equivalence: HEURISTIC PROXY: 0 g row with a unit-proven forced-flow speed u [cm/s]; g_eff = min(1.5, (u/35)^2)
methods.e_field_ion_body_force: HEURISTIC PROXY: ion-driven body-force equivalent of an applied electric field (requires a stated E_1g-equivalent calibration)

convective_velocity_equivalence.formula: g_eff = min(1.5, (u / 35.0)^2),  u = |forced-flow speed| in cm/s
convective_velocity_equivalence.derivation: u_b = C_b*sqrt(g*g0*L_c) (E1); L_c = 5 cm, C_b = alpha*sqrt(dT/T_inf) = 0.5 with dT/T_inf ~ 5 (assumed by the project owner) -> u_b(1 g) = 35 cm/s; g_eff = (u/u_b(1g))^2. u = 14 cm/s -> 0.16 g, 22 -> 0.395 g, 35 -> 1.0 g.
convective_velocity_equivalence.applies_to: rows with actual gravity 0.0 and airflow_cm_s populated from a column whose cm/s unit is proven in the table (PSI-98/99/100 'Air Flow (cm/s)', PSI-101 'Inlet velocity (cm/s)', PSI-102 'Air Flow (cm/s)', PSI-107 'Air Rate (cm/s)'). u = 0 (no forced flow) stays 'direct' 0.0 g. PSI-25/26 'Air display' has no stated unit and is excluded.
caveats: forced flow and natural convection are not equivalent for flame spread; the proxy matches a velocity scale only
negative PSI-107 'Air Rate' values (sensor-signed) are used by magnitude
values above 42.9 cm/s are capped at 1.5 g_eff

e_field_ion_body_force.status: NOT APPLIED - no calibration constant and no per-row field/voltage values in PSI-22 files
e_field_ion_body_force.found: investigation text states 'high voltage (up to 10 kV) differential between the burner and a flat circular mesh'; the table has no voltage / field / gap column (columns: Test Type, Test Day, Year, Month, Date, Mesh Polarity, Fuel Bottle, Fuel Conc, Flames Ignited, Notes).
e_field_ion_body_force.needed: an E_1g-equivalent constant (field strength, kV/cm or V with the burner-mesh gap, that cancels 1 g of buoyancy) from the PSI-22 team or from the literature (e.g. the publication 'Canceling buoyancy of gaseous fuel flames in a gravitational environment using an ion-driven wind' listed in the PSI-22 record), plus per-test applied voltages and the electrode gap. g_eff would then be min(1, |E| / E_1g-equiv).

definition.gravity_match_in_ranking: Sim_gravity = max(actual-gravity match, 0.25 x effective-gravity proxy match); the proxy component is reported separately (sim_gravity_proxy, gravity_basis='proxy') and down-weighted so it never equals an actual match.

caveat: All PSI rows are ISS / Cygnus flight work at actual gravity 0.0 g (project baseline; per-row ground tags would show 1.0 g). Rows in the 0.16 / 0.38 / 1.0 g regimes above are 0 g rows whose forced-flow speed maps to that buoyancy-equivalent velocity (HEURISTIC PROXY, Lc = 5 cm, dT/Tinf ~ 5). They are NOT measured Moon / Mars / Earth gravity data.

source_label: VERIFIED NASA PSI EXPERIMENTAL DATA - 2,051 rows from 19 files
provenance_note: Every row is parsed from files downloaded from psi.nasa.gov (see source_files). Units are converted only where the file itself states the unit (see /api/conversions); quantities a file does not state are NULL. gravity_g (actual gravity) = 0.0 is a project-level ISS / Cygnus flight baseline (gravity_inferred=true; gravity_source says whether the PSI JSON names ISS/Cygnus/MSG/CIR or the value is user-stated) and never tabulated; row-level ground tags would set 1.0. effective_gravity_g is a HEURISTIC PROXY (flow-equivalent), never measured partial gravity (see /api/effective-gravity). Empirical predictors are exposed only if they beat dummy baselines under group cross-validation (/api/model-audit); otherwise the nearest real experimental tests are returned. Research triage, not a certified determination.
